SIMPLE ENGLISH
SDLC is the process of planning, building, verifying, releasing and maintaining software.
Iterative teams revisit stages as they learn.

A pharmacy starts with stock requirements, builds a small release, then improves it from user
feedback.
Requirements Design Implement Test Deploy Maintain · Feedback / revisit · Read the diagram: Follow the activities and feedback loop. · පියවර සහ feedback loop එක බලන්න.

Q: Is SDLC always sequential?
A: No. The phases describe activities; iterative approaches revisit them.
